text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, I blew it~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating way too much, Teach~! 
It's not that bad of an injury at all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's get back to training! 
Maya's an adult now, so this is totally 
fine—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm... o-kay... Grown-ups say it doesn't 
hurt even if it does!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's why you shouldn't say it hurts!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It looks childish and uncool... I hate 
it~~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Quietly...? You mean staying still?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“I see... That's part of being an 'adult' 
too.”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Okay! Maya doesn't hurt at all, though. 
I'll be a good girl and rest like a 
grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It totally... doesn't hurt at all, 
though...

And so, somehow or another, I managed to 
get Mayano Top Gun to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainie... But...
choice_data_list:
It's way less cool to push yourself and 
make things worse.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hau! You're totally right!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...B-But I'm fine! It just hurts a little, 
it's not an injury that'll get worse—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!! Owwwww!!

Because of trying to show off, the injury 
worsened, resulting in having to rest for 
several days...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell you the truth, it really hurts 
a lot. Where I got injured."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I really wanna give it my all 
in training with you, Trainer-chan...!
choice_data_list:
Let's get plenty of rest and give it our 
best again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

Though it took time for the injury to 
heal... she managed to regain her strength 
and spirits.
